_comment: Citations for every aggregated comparison data point. Each entry references which study or article the finding came from. Live retailer fetches were attempted but blocked at every layer (sandbox proxy + retailer WAFs); this dataset was compiled by aggregating published 2025-2026 basket comparison studies via WebSearch.

sources.name: Consumer Reports — Most and Least Expensive Supermarkets
sources.method: Strategic Resource Group basket survey, 30+ retailers, 6 metro areas (Boston, Chicago, DFW, Denver, Virginia Beach, LA/SoCal)
key_findings: Costco 21.4% below Walmart baseline
BJ's 21.0% below Walmart
Lidl 8.5% below Walmart
Aldi 8.3% below Walmart
WinCo 3.3% below Walmart
Kroger 14.8% above Walmart
Trader Joe's 24.6% above Walmart

sources.name: Moneywise / Yahoo Finance — 32-item Walmart vs Costco showdown
key_findings: Costco basket 26% cheaper overall
Walmart wins chicken (-$0.42/lb), sugar, flour, eggs (-$0.15/dozen)
Costco wins cheese ($2.60 vs $3.46/lb), butter ($2.12 vs $3.23/lb), popcorn, crackers

sources.name: Cheapism — 50 staples Costco vs Kroger
key_findings: Costco cheaper on 43 of 50 items (86%)
Kroger cheaper on 4 items even with loyalty card
Costco savings exceeded 40% on 10 items

sources.name: AARP — Aldi/Walmart/Target 30+ item basket
sources.method: 30+ item identical basket priced at all three
key_findings: Aldi $66.11, Walmart $67.63, Target $83.62
Aldi 23% cheaper than Target on the basket

sources.name: Cheapism — Aldi vs Walmart vs Kroger
key_findings: Aldi $67.34, Walmart $78.23, Kroger $90.82
Aldi 14% cheaper than Walmart, 24% cheaper than Kroger
Aldi cheapest on 33 of 41 items (80%)

sources.name: GoBankingRates — Walmart vs Sam's Club 2026
sources.method: Per-unit comparison across grocery and household categories
key_findings: Sam's Club ~25% cheaper per pound on average
Sam's wins detergent pods, peanut butter, $4.98 rotisserie chicken
Sam's 10lb sugar $6.58 vs Walmart $8
Walmart wins frozen veggies, 2% milk, diapers, smaller pack sizes
Cheddar ~30% cheaper at Sam's; milk ~20% cheaper at Walmart

sources.name: Suburbs101 — Costco vs Sam's Club 21 bulk items
key_findings: Sam's cheaper on 10 of 25 items, Costco 8 of 25, ties on 6 of 25
Sam's MM paper towels $0.009/sheet vs Costco Kirkland $0.012/sheet
Costco TP 1.4¢/sqft vs Sam's 1.8¢/sqft
Tide laundry tied at 12¢/oz both clubs

sources.name: LendEDU — Amazon vs Walmart vs Target 50-product basket
key_findings: Walmart 1.73% cheaper than Amazon overall
Target 1.24% more expensive than Amazon
Walmart and Target both beat Amazon on Food & Beverage (4.61% and 7.30%)

sources.name: GroceryChop — Walmart vs Target 2026
key_findings: Walmart 5-15% cheaper than Target without discounts
As of Dec 2025, Walmart $1+ cheaper than Target on whole cart
Target Circle + RedCard closes the gap

sources.name: GroceryChop — Kroger vs Walmart
key_findings: Walmart $107.82 vs Kroger $116.83 — Walmart 7.7% cheaper
Great Value cereal ~15-20% cheaper than Kroger Brand

sources.name: Tasting Table — Aldi vs Costco 8 foods
key_findings: Aldi wins all 5 meat/seafood: ground beef ($6.89 vs $6.99), chicken breast ($2.49 vs $3.69), chicken thighs ($1.55 vs $2.19), bacon ($4.49 vs $6.24/lb), shrimp ($6.99 vs $9.49/lb)
Costco flour $0.35/lb vs Aldi $0.47/lb
Aldi rice $0.66/lb vs Costco $0.99/lb
Aldi butter $3.49 vs Costco $4.24/lb

sources.name: Krazy Coupon Lady — Target vs Walmart 65+ items
key_findings: Chicken breast: Target $2.56/lb vs Walmart $2.57/lb (tie)
Olive oil 17oz: Walmart Great Value $5.97 vs Target Good & Gather $6.39
AP flour 5lb: Walmart Great Value $1.97 vs Target $2.19

sources.name: Thrifty Family — 11-item Aldi vs Walmart
key_findings: Aldi delivered 12.7% lower average cost across 127-item basket vs Walmart
Aldi 9.6% cheaper national average ($78.42 vs $85.97)
Aldi 12.3% cheaper in Portland and Denver
Aldi 15-30% cheaper than Walmart on overlapping items

sources.name: Yahoo / GoBankingRates — Amazon vs Costco grocery basket
key_findings: Costco $99.93 basket = $159.74 on Amazon (60% premium on Amazon)
Amazon Food & Beverage 120% more expensive than Costco on average
Costco 25% cheaper on household essentials vs Amazon

sources.name: The Takeout — Walmart/Aldi/Target/Costco 2026 essentials
key_findings: Walmart Great Value eggs $1.67/dozen, Aldi Goldhen $1.85/dozen, Costco $4.53/2dz ($2.27/dozen)
Walmart whole milk $2.66/gal; Costco $0.03 cheaper
Costco butter 16 sticks $12.47 ($0.78/stick); Aldi $0.75/stick
Bread: Aldi L'oven $1.25, Walmart Great Value $1.48, Target Market Pantry $1.59

sources.name: Fortune — Amazon Fresh / Walmart / Target price cuts
key_findings: Amazon Fresh cut prices on 4,000 items in May 2024 to match Walmart/Target

sources.name: Hip2Save — paper towel buying guide
key_findings: Costco Kirkland $0.0135/sheet vs Bounty $0.0208/sheet (35% premium for name brand)
Walmart Great Value Choose-a-Size single roll $0.005/sheet (cheapest store brand)
Sam's 12-pack Bounty Select-a-Size $19.98

sources.name: Krazy Coupon Lady — toilet paper deals
key_findings: Scott TP via Amazon S&S as low as 5.8¢ per 100 sheets
Quilted Northern Amazon S&S $0.027/sqft vs Walmart everyday $0.032/sqft

sources.name: Southern Savers — Costco vs Amazon OTC/vitamins
key_findings: Costco Kirkland Ibuprofen 200mg $8.79 for 1000ct ($0.0087/pill)
Target up&up Ibuprofen 200mg $13.90/1000ct ($0.0139/pill)
Costco wins 18 of 28 items vs Amazon
Kirkland Aller-Tec (cetirizine) 365ct $14.49 ($0.04/pill)

sources.name: Consumer Checkbook 2025 supermarket survey
key_findings: Aldi 30-40% lower than the average grocery store
